title: Bilirubin, indirect (unconjugated)

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: Indirect (unconjugated) bilirubin is bilirubin made from the breakdown of old red blood cells that the liver has not yet processed. It is one part of total bilirubin.
context: Some medicines, certain foods and strenuous exercise can affect bilirubin. Indirect bilirubin is usually read together with total and direct bilirubin.
aboveRange: Faster breakdown of red blood cells
Some medicines, certain foods or strenuous exercise
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
